async function getToken() {
  try {
      const response = await fetch('https://app-sociodotabuleiro.us.auth0.com/oauth/token', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          "client_id":"qm2vfRYSGSfVLidoXVtzGcXbCLGHmhUI",
          "client_secret":"O0g-3Fta-HUW6ro56PAKIuLQhHFdmhSxtq1Jqs3_YkJL2DW5YSk-f447lOoDSkDN",
          "audience":"https://api.sociodotabuleiro",
          "grant_type":"client_credentials"
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      console.log(data);
  } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching token:', error);
  }
};
In this example, client_id and client_secret are the ones from the Socio do Tabuleiro API (Test Application) application. You can change these values with any from your other authorized applications.

You can now extract the access_token property from the response to make authorized requests to your API.

Sending the token to the API

You can use this bearer token with an Authorization Header in your request to obtain authorized access to your API.

curl --request GET \
  --url http://path_to_your_api/ \
  --header 'authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCIsImtpZCI6IkVCdUdUaldUSkprRU1ianpJXzV2NyJ9..BHC3U3JJz1J7WWgEQQ6YXuUsC2qF-5WF-n0VxCNqz4o0B-jGVK5PrTFZ4xgbd5UDAhw-s0CoM5MrInzBAohWxvwsufoXoKXL55HaCZ-Q9p9wJ3wUIxfDKMe-2_HZPa1RlfiIozxdt894YL1ieNUqMOmWORg8_AGdJvVeZti8rzxyjQKsfNIr5Mz3a3jlWToQuFLMiAvjrq_RJFe_FptCzXKP5q2BN0_iBQ4D9HrOsi1m8EHEGLHZT6vt7w8N3zPpyRuOWVzK0N3SRgw3ri0V8ej9_dqtjZLqZdBjGJbqidMppT3ypI6l7UeYLGG33ul0DPxfdJivp7622CImMwIIOw'
